Escape score and copper visibility follow-up - 2026-10-29
#167 reporter: Kittingsl. IN PROGRESS / awaiting visual confirmation.
The first cube pass was rejected as too faint. This revision retains sporadic
independent timing, 3-cue cap, scatter and wall occlusion, but uses the torch's
exact FLAME_COL.copper core/mantle/fringe and raises peak opacity .2 -> .9.
Native 2-3px cube faces remain crisp. Smooth fades and reduced-flashing scale
are retained. No dotted line, circle or new generated image asset.

Owner music request: Blackout_Run_For_Your_Life_8min.mp3
Source SHA256 ca955cee2286a13136a2dc8b81b7a43f1011998f6462f5fa468664033c70315c
Source bytes 15361581, 480s stereo. FFmpeg measured mean -17.1 dB, peak -2.4 dB.
The neighbouring generation_manifest.json records ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo, four
180 BPM/E minor acoustic survival-horror passages joined by 5.333s equal-power
crossfades. Prompt summary/processing are credited in README. Original MP3
unchanged. Full track encoded at 48kbps stereo to constrained-VBR Opus/Ogg and
24kHz MP3. 20ms in / 50ms out edge fades avoid a click on repeat; no time stretch
or duration reduction. Delivered sizes: Ogg 2941318 B, MP3 2880524 B.

mus_escape now owns mus_blackout-escape; title/descent keep Beacon Run. Existing
post-Beacon timing, stingers and music ducking are unchanged. One Audio element
and media/source graph are reused, switching src only for changed delivery.
Long tracks are streamed rather than decoded into memory. Opus unsupported ->
MP3. Music slider/mute route through the existing music bus. Track replacement
increments a generation cursor so an outgoing play() rejection cannot mark the
incoming track blocked. Intentional pause aborts are likewise ignored.
HMR fills optional resource fields additively; State and main.ts untouched.
